title.native: 多田くんは恋をしない

synonyms: ทาดะคุงไม่ตกหลุมรัก
description:
Mitsuyoshi Tada, a boy who has never known love, is taking pictures of the cherry blossoms in full bloom when he meets Teresa Wagner, a transfer student from Luxembourg. Upon arriving in Japan, she got lost, separated from her travel companion. Mitsuyoshi helps her and brings her to his grandfather's coffee shop.

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description: He is in his second year at the Ginga University Affiliated Koinohoshi High School. He wants to become a photographer just like his late father, and is working at Tada Coffee Shop, which is run by his grandfather. He is a part of the photography club at school, and his specialty is atmospheric pictures. He doesn't talk much, but he is a kind boy who works very hard and cares for his friends. Those around him sometimes envy him, because he is always himself and very attentive to his surroundings. He lives with his grandfather, his sister [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/125339/Tada-Yui), and his beloved cat [Nyanko Big](https://anilist.co/character/161337/Big-Nyanko) in a corner of Ginza.

A student from the European country of Luxembourg. She is a beautiful girl with blonde hair and bright, jade-like green eyes. She has a bubbly and honest personality, and always has a bright smile on her face. She loves a Japanese historical drama called "Rainbow Shogun" and even though she is really good with Japanese, she sometimes ends up using samurai language. She is living together with [Alexandra](https://anilist.co/character/125337/Magritte-Alexandra), who is also a fellow exchange student and they also like to spend a lot of time together.

~!She is the princess of Luxembourg.!~

She is a childhood friend of Hajime and part of the photography club. She was forced into joining the club by Hajime so that they could meet the quota. She is an honor student who can handle anything and has a vast amount of knowledge. She wears her long hair in a braid. Ijuin and Tada are in the same class as her and since she is part of the student council, the members of the club call her 'student rep.' She is very modest and serious and wants to change herself, so she is making an effort to do so.

He is a childhood friend of Tada and also a member of the photography club. If he doesn't open his mouth, he actually is quite handsome but sadly he can never keep it shut long enough to fool anyone. He is due to take over his family's famous restaurant in Ginza, so he is very good at cooking. When they were small, Tada saved him from a dangerous situation so he thinks of Tada as his one and only friend. Because he often spends his days at the Tada Coffee Shop, he is also good friends with Grandpa and Yui, but since he is hated strongly by Nyanko Big, he goes into self-defense mode whenever they meet.

name.native: アレクサンドラ・マグリット

node.description:
Alexandra came together with Teresa as an exchange student and is also from Luxembourg. 

She is childhood friends with Teresa and often acts as her guardian. To protect her, she would do anything. 

She isn't just smart, but also strong and is very calm and serious. She doesn't laugh much, but as she gets closer to Ijuin her ability to read between the lines is shaking him. However, she also has a side to her that loves romantic books and movies.

He is in the year above Mitsuyoshi and is the president of the photography club. His club members refer to him as the 'in-focus-senpai.' He is very bright and gets good grades, but unfortunately tends to say exactly what's on his mind. His dream for the future is to be a photographer of nudes and thinks unsavory thoughts no matter when and where. He is an enthusiastic fan of the gravure idol and model HINA. He often argues with his childhood friend Hinako Hasegawa.

Mitsuyoshi's younger sister who keeps her black hair in a bob. She has a bright and bubbly personality. Since losing both her parents, she has looked up to her grandfather and older brother as parental figures, and has a sibling-like relationship with the cat Nyanko Big. She enjoys mystery novels, and is currently into the "Sunflower Express Love Incidents" series.

She looks up to Yamashita and holds secret feelings for him. It seems she is trying to keep her crush a secret, but it is so obvious that everybody knows.

Yamashita is the only first-year member of the photography club, and Tada and Ijuin are his upperclassmen. He's an androgynous pretty boy with a tall, slim frame and fluffy hair which he always clips back. He went to the same middle school as Tada, so they have had a lower/upperclassman relationship for a while. He has a deep respect for Tada to the point he seems like a loyal puppy. Therefore the other group members have given him the nickname 'Yamashita-Ken,' with 'Ken' being written with the character for 'dog.' He loves animals, but unfortunately, they don't seem to love him back. Of course Nyanko Big doesn't like him either.

alternative: シャルル・ド・ロワール

node.description: Charles is a descendant of French nobility. He is an exceptional person because even though he is a second year university student, he is also a competent company president. He not only has great reflexes but is also a gentle person full of consideration for others. He seems like a superman that can do anything. He has been in contact with Teresa since they were children.

Rescued and adopted cat of Mitsuyoshi Tada 10 years ago in s1 timeline. He is proud of Mitsuyoshi and has watched over him as he grew. He has his own internet blog where Mitsuyoshi Tada uploads daily.
